# Release preparation: 2026.11.0

Prepared on 8 November 2026 for the dependency update in
[`da5915d`](https://github.com/nicokempe/nuxt-feature-flags-module/commit/da5915df85ef0e49b2223f4ae53b5e830116fddd).
The repository's release script calculated `2026.11.0` using Europe/Berlin calendar versioning.
The release is prepared for publishing through the existing **Release** workflow.

## Compatibility and upgrade notes

- **Node.js requirement:** `^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0`, matching `@nuxt/kit` 4.6.4.
  Users of older Node.js 20 or 22 releases, or Node.js 21, must upgrade. The package now
  declares this requirement in `engines.node`.
- Feature flag configuration, composables, middleware, directives, and server APIs are unchanged.
- The repository's Nuxt 4.6.4 development stack requires Node.js
  `^22.22.3 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0`. CI uses Node.js 24.21.0; local validation used 24.22.1.
- Node.js types now follow the Node.js 24 CI runtime. The proposed Node.js 26 type upgrade was
  superseded to avoid allowing APIs unavailable in CI.
- TypeScript remains at 5.9.3, satisfying the module builder's `^5.9.3` peer requirement.
  DevTools remains on the compatible 3.x line used by Nuxt 4.6.4.
- Vitest 5.1.0 is a development-only major upgrade. The test suite passes with its updated runner.

## Packaging and verification

- Production packaging removes development stub symlinks before building, preventing writes
  through `dist/runtime` into the source directory.
- The build configuration explicitly identifies the separately emitted local flag validator.
  Build warnings remain fatal.
- Integration tests now check enabled, disabled, and wildcard flags through real SSR and a
  server handler.
- Lint, all 23 tests, both type checks, all six release-policy tests, package build and packing,
  package import, and the Cloudflare Pages playground production build passed.
- [GitHub Validate run](https://github.com/nicokempe/nuxt-feature-flags-module/actions/runs/42519372999)
  passed for the dependency commit.
- Dependency PRs #179, #181, #183, #184, #185, #186, #187, and #188 were superseded and closed.
  Unrelated PRs #10 and #17 remain open.

## Dependency audit

`pnpm audit --prod` reported zero advisories. The full development/build dependency tree retains
three upstream advisories: two moderate and one low, with no high or critical advisories.

| Package | Resolved vulnerable version | Upstream situation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `deepmerge` | 4.3.1 | [GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4): no published patched version |
| `glob` | 13.0.7 | [GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4): fix requires 14.0.2 or later |
| `minimatch` | 10.2.6 | [GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249): fix requires 11.0.1 or later |

These versions are brought in by the current build, lint, and Nitro toolchains. Major-version
overrides were not forced across their upstream dependency contracts.

## Publish procedure

Run [Release](https://github.com/nicokempe/nuxt-feature-flags-module/actions/workflows/release.yml)
from `main`; there are no input fields. The workflow generates the version and changelog,
validates the release, creates its commit and tag, publishes to npm through trusted publishing,
and creates the GitHub Release. Do not publish a GitHub release manually before this workflow.

The version and generated changelog have not been committed separately; this preserves the
workflow's release allocation and recovery rules. A release started in another month will receive
that month's calendar version instead.
